profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at SynkedUP
profile.summary: Software Engineer with experience building rock solid software for scale. I work in .NET and Javascript, but am constantly learning new ways to create technical solutions. I speak at conferences and blog from time to time.

positions.title: Software Craftsman
positions.description:
Transitioning from a monolithic web app and fewer than 15 developers to a large distributed system with over 150 developers. Work on key parts of the system from idea through implementation and maintenance, including: 
Identity Management - supporting multiple authentication schemes (password, SAML, OAuth), GDPR compliance, and ensuring security of user’s data.
Authorization - centralize the logic that decides which features are accessible for a given user, enabling the company to iterate faster on product ideas. Architected to be highly available and very performant (<10ms API response times).
Technical Lead on a team doing Continuous Delivery using Lean methodologies. My team typically deploys several times per day using a highly collaborative workflow (pair programming and mob programming). With no QA team, we are responsible for all software testing and have a very low bug count.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: I work on language and literacy software that is designed to make learning English fun for elementary school children.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Developed accounting software for city and county governments. Worked on a project migrating the product from VB.NET to C#.
